note:
Reviewed opposing identities: The Federal transport and embarked guard opposed Watie’s Confederate shore force. Only the latter has verified equipment here. The transport hull remains unclassified; unknown force and loss quantities cannot establish a numerical ratio. The Oklahoma Historical Society dates the capture to 15 June 1864, conflicting with the imported 10 May date. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: Watie’s Confederate force is represented by its field artillery on the south bank, not by a ship. The Federal participant remains naval for the transport and its embarked guard; the transport hull is unclassified because its propulsion layout has not been verified. The Oklahoma Historical Society dates the capture to 15 June 1864, whereas the imported catalogue date is 10 May 1864; this patch does not change that disputed date.
